title.marksRule: the mark is the icon of the coloured key that leads there: Home (with Cargo), Vivarium, Research, Library. `habitat` is the screen id of one mibi up close, a level of the Vivarium

back.roomRule: the word's room is the slot less the cap and its gap, 88 − 16 − 4; a wider word reads "Back". The longest title word, "Vivarium" (66 px), fits

marks.faceNote: a Station master painted at 24, never a scaled Companion face
marks.faceRule: the one face place names one carried mibi: the Companion's lead when it is carried (grown or not), else the first id in carried order (state.carriedIds, the set as it is, never a waiting request); none carried: face-24-empty. K4's partner is the Companion's and is never shown here. Until the three face places of station-layouts.md (the top bar's Companion zone, faces at 800, 828 and 856, 8, 24×24, in carried order) replace it

rail.note: The shared chapter rail (station-layouts.md, The chapter rail): tabs are parallelograms hanging from the top bar's rule (y 40 to 80), both sides leaning 16 px right over the height, touching along their slants (pitch = width, run = sum of widths + 16). One to six chapters: full tabs of 136. Seven to twelve: compact tabs of 56 and the open chapter's tab full. Every bench screen centres the run on x 512, snapped down to the grid (Pods since its three states, 2026-10-09). A hanging tab does not lift.

forms.round: a rounded rectangle `outside` px outside the target's box, `width` wide, corner `radius`: [x − 4, y − 4, w + 8, h + 8]
forms.feet: an ellipse under a creature (focus.feet): w + widen (16) wide, 24 tall, at [x + ((w + 1) >> 1) − ((ew + 1) >> 1), y + h − 12], centred on the feet line y + h
forms.circle: { "circle": { "radius": r, "centre": [dx, dy] } }: a ring 2r by 2r round (x + dx, y + dy); or { "circle": { "outside": n } }: radius (w >> 1) + n round (x + (w >> 1), y + (h >> 1)); `width` wide
forms.tab: the rail tab's ring (focus.ring.tab), its box (x − 4, 42, w + 24, 42)
forms.where: each screen spec's target group carries its form as `ring`; a group without one wears `round`; any other form or key is refused when the spec loads

ring.onPaperNote: on the tome's paper (the Library, the Book's face spread and its guide spread) the ring is rust (#a6420c) with the same geometry; on the open plate it may cover that plate's open rule (UI designer, 2026-10-09)

tab.note: the slants stop at the tab's bottom edge (y 80) and drop straight to the bottom run at y 84

strings.note: every word in the frame is a slot the copywriter fills to its zone's rule (station-layouts.md, The frame); the titles are today's words. Was: turn "T{n}", backArrow "← ", dot " · " (the dot-joined parts go)

idle.status: Idle is the Vivarium's whole without the frame: one painting, the whole's window a 1:1 part of it; the idle timer, the wake, what moves and the line; wireframe station-layouts/10-idle.svg
idle.purpose: a living view the Station can show permanently, all day: the Vivarium with its residents awake and moving, in full light. Never a screen off, a sleep, a dimmed or blanked screen
idle.state: props.idle = true: the whole 1024×600 is Idle's composition. The top bar, the bottom line, the message plate and the focus ring are not drawn, and the screen under Idle keeps its state and focus unseen

theWhole.rule: the Vivarium's whole shows rows 120 to 560 of this painting in its window (0, 40, 1024, 440), 1:1: a resident at y on Idle stands at y − 80 on the whole, and its ground band (0, 296, 1024, 176) is this band. One painting a light (day, dusk, night), never cropped and enlarged

resident.order: draw order of the residents and the bed: by their feet's y, lower in front (drawn later), left first on a tie; the bed and its sleepers sort as one, at the bed's foot (y 552)
resident.moves: awake: each walks, rests and plays its species' idle on the seed the face steps, as on Home and the whole

ink.rule: the nap pose's ink is at most 96 wide and 88 tall, centred on footX and bottom-aligned on footY in its box: at most [footX − 48, 448, 96, 88]; three sit on the 192 px bed

sleepers.markNote: no mark on a sleeper: the nap pose says it
sleepers.moves: the nap pose breathing, nothing else

states.docked: the carried set asleep, one to three, in carried order

strip.binding: idleLine is a composition in the frame's binding table, not a word

idle.moves: the residents and the sleepers, and the light, which follows the time of day; nothing blinks, nothing counts down, the line changes only when what it says changes (a cut). The waiting lamp may show on a resident, steady

bed.note: UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29: the Vivarium's whole's bed roles (vivarium.json colours.bed), one bed in one painting

from: the rest knob's ✓ on Home (home.json events.rest)
the idle timer: 60 s without a press, on any screen, never during a hold, Cargo's opening or its report card

keys.any: the first press sends `wake` and nothing else: no ring moves, nothing opens, nothing is spent
keys.dock: the Caddy's Dock is a world event, never a Station key: it wakes, docks and lands on Home with the ring on the room, then the crates slide into the Cargo module (home.json events.crateIn); lifting the Companion from Idle wakes and lifts, and the screen under Idle shows

wake.to: the screen under Idle, its focus as it was

idle.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): the dither to Idle and the wake are cuts, so the host sends hold 0 with them (enter.hold and wake.hold are 180 with motion on); the first press still only wakes. Nothing on Idle cuts (habitat.json notes.cut)

strings.line: one sentence, six words or fewer, no digits
strings.orderRule: the first that holds shows; none: the line is empty; never a demand, nothing nags. `out` only while the Companion is away with mibis carried; docked, nothing about them

crates.1: a crate waits in the bay
crates.2: two crates wait in the bay
crates.3: three crates wait in the bay

out.2: two mibis are with the Companion
out.3: three mibis are with the Companion

notBuilt.status: the composition a screen shows while the face has no binding table for it; wireframes station-layouts/13-not-built.svg (on Home) and 13b-not-built-idle.svg (Idle)
notBuilt.purpose: say plainly that this screen is not built yet, keep the frame and navigation working, and promise nothing the screen cannot do
notBuilt.when: a screen with no binding table in the face's screens/ (props.state = "notBuilt"); Idle (props.idle) with no Idle binding
notBuilt.draws: the frame as on every screen (the title from strings.titles, the counters, the Companion mark, the turn, the bottom line, the message plate), the frame's stage part with no slice in colours.stageGround, and the line; no picture, no targets, no focus ring

line.binding: notBuilt is a composition in the frame's binding table, as idleLine is; it adds no word and no layout rule

ground.note: Idle only: the whole screen in the ground, under the line; on a framed screen the frame's stage part is the ground

bottomLine.action: empty: no ✓ cap, no verb, no price
bottomLine.subject: empty
bottomLine.need: the frame's notice as on every screen (the line's need left null, so the default notice shows), amber, with its 12×12 lamp
bottomLine.back: the ← cap and the parent's word from navigation.screens; none on Home

keys.confirm: nothing: no intent acted on, no plate
keys.pad: nothing: there are no targets and no ring
keys.back: to the parent in navigation.screens (the stack rule); on Home nothing
keys.room: as navigation.roomKeys, from every not-built screen
keys.dock: as on every screen: docks or lifts the Companion and lands on Home; with Home not built no arrival plays and nothing is held: the counters and the turn take their new values at once, and the notice names the crates
keys.idle: the idle timer runs on every not-built screen; Idle not built draws ground and line only, and the first press sends wake and nothing else, back to the screen under it (180 ms dither, held)

strings.line: this screen is not built yet
strings.rule: one sentence in lower case, as the frame's notices and Idle's line, a name keeping its capital; no digits, no full stop; on a framed screen the name is the top bar's title, never repeated in the line; Idle has no title, so its line names it

navigation.rule: Home is the hub; Incubator and Probe under Home with the Research mark; a room key always opens its room's top; stack navigation (← to the parent of the screen you are on, never to the history); the first press on Idle only wakes; a room key pressed on Create or Cross drops the unpaid choices, and coming back starts fresh

keys.pad: moves the ring inside this screen (on Create and Cross, the focused choice); never leaves the screen, never spends
keys.confirm: does the bottom line's action exactly; no ✓ cap, nothing happens
keys.back: goes to this screen's parent, and the way back names it with this screen's back word; no parent, no ← cap and nothing happens
keys.room: opens the room's top screen from anywhere, even from inside the room; never spends

research.focus: the pod that most needs the player

book.turn: ◀ ▶ past the spread's edge; ← reads Library on both (library.json spreads)

sitting.steps: inside the sitting ← goes back a step (place to pose, look and confirm to place); from the pose step it goes to the Vivarium (sitting.json keys.back)

navigation.podBack: {pod} is the pod's label ("Loika"); a name wider than the way back's 68 px for its word reads "Back"

jumps.focus: the pod that most needs the player
jumps.when: a new pod landed in the rack

jumps.focus: the first identified pod in rack order, else the first pod
jumps.when: the rack holds a pod and a bay is free

navigation.jumpRule: stack navigation: after a jump, ← goes to the parent of the screen you are on in this tree, never back along the way you came

homePad.upDown: walk the instrument column; among the residents, the nearest one that way
homePad.leftRight: cross between the vivarium's residents and the instrument column, landing on the row nearest the ring
homePad.homeKeyOnHome: the ring back on the room, where ✓ does what needs the player

leaving.create: a room key drops the unpaid choices; coming back starts fresh
leaving.cross: a room key drops the unpaid choices; coming back starts fresh
